title: 鉄肺の村と、渡りぬる鳥の葬列
author: 丑満 ミコト

en.title: The Village of the Iron Lung and the Funeral Procession of Migratory Birds
en.premise: Deep in the mountains lies Karasunaru Village, home to a colossal steam-driven ritual apparatus known as the 'Iron Lung.' Each season, as migratory birds arrive, the villagers perform a ritual of billowing steam, maintaining peace by mimicking the breath of a god. But one year, the birds cease to come, and the village's sacred taboos begin to crumble. A young man returning to his hometown witnesses something writhing beyond the veil of steam—something that is neither bird nor human.

zh.title: 铁肺之村与候鸟的葬列
zh.premise: 深山之中的鸦鸣村，拥有一台被称为“铁肺”的巨大蒸汽驱动祭祀装置。每逢候鸟飞来之季，村民们便举行喷发蒸汽的祭礼，通过模仿神之气息来维持村庄的安宁。然而某年，候鸟突然绝迹，村中的禁忌随之崩塌。一名返乡的青年，在蒸汽的烟雾彼端，目击到了某种既非鸟类也非人类的“东西”在蠢蠢欲动。
